_comment: mcp-run server registry. Secret-bearing MCP servers launch through ~/.local/bin/mcp-run. To add a server: add an entry here, then reference it from the mcphub config (~/.config/mcphub/servers.json) with { "command": "/home/erikzen/.local/bin/mcp-run", "args": ["<name>"] }.

_disabled_servers._comment: Previously active servers, kept for reference. Move back under 'servers' to re-enable.

AUTH_HEADER._comment: Bitwarden item holding the Balcon Padel MCP bearer token. Adjust 'item' to match your vault entry; 'field' defaults to 'password'.
